dataset.name: Notional Maritime Production & Support Challenge — Configuration Rules Register
dataset.fictionalisation_notice: All configuration rules, incompatibilities, effectivity constraints, actions and technical conditions are fictional and simplified for hackathon prototyping. They do not represent real engineering, product configuration, airworthiness, seaworthiness, cyber-security or maintenance-release rules.
dataset.generated_for: Industrial AI Hackathon — Operational Co-pilot Challenge

rules.title: APR-220 Revision-D Installation Procedure Applicability
rules.violation_message: APR-220 configuration revision D must use the revision-D installation procedure and arrangement description. Legacy revision-B instructions are incompatible.
rules.rationale: Synthetic revision-D configuration uses bracket type D, harness route D and a different mounting-torque value from revision B.
rules.test_case_hint: Select TASK-001 and intentionally retrieve INFO-APR-INST-REV-B to demonstrate the violation.

rules.title: APR Module Replacement Requires Accepted Post-Maintenance Test
rules.violation_message: Sensor-rack maintenance cannot be closed or released until the required post-maintenance test has an accepted result.
rules.rationale: Synthetic task workflow requires evidence of functional, self-test, interface, cooling-path and signal-path checks.
rules.test_case_hint: Attempt to close TASK-003 while TASK-002 has no accepted test result.

rules.title: APR-180 Revision-C Procedure and Drawing Effectivity
rules.violation_message: APR-180 configuration revision C requires the APR-C document set. APR-220 documents do not establish applicability for this equipment model.
rules.rationale: Synthetic APR-180 configuration-C equipment uses a distinct mounting arrangement and traceability workflow.
rules.test_case_hint: Select TASK-014 and compare the applicable APR-C documents with the APR-D procedure.

rules.title: MCS-NX-500 Hardware and Software Update Compatibility
rules.violation_message: MCS-NX-500 software baseline SW-4.0 cannot be applied or accepted until the matching revision-C hardware update is installed and evidenced.
rules.rationale: Synthetic hardware/software pairing rule prevents mixed-baseline configuration.
rules.test_case_hint: Attempt TASK-009 before TASK-008 is complete to demonstrate a blocked update.

rules.title: SCG-210 Revision-E Checklist Applicability
rules.violation_message: SCG-210 configuration revision E must be verified using the revision-E checklist. The revision-C checklist is obsolete and cannot provide configuration evidence.
rules.rationale: Synthetic gateway revision-E verification introduces evidence and sign-off requirements not present in the legacy checklist.
rules.test_case_hint: Select TASK-011 and retrieve the revision-C checklist to demonstrate an explicit mismatch.

rules.title: CDU-90 Cooling Clearance and Functional-Test Rule
rules.violation_message: A cooling-line clearance below the synthetic 40 mm threshold requires routing rework and a subsequent functional verification before return to service.
rules.rationale: Synthetic physical-constraint rule ties an inspection finding to mandatory corrective and test workflow steps.
rules.test_case_hint: Create a mock inspection result with 25 mm clearance to generate the follow-on workflow.

rules.title: ACP-140 Inspection Finding Must Be Resolved Before Functional Test
rules.violation_message: ACP-140 functional verification cannot begin while an inspection finding remains open or unreviewed.
rules.rationale: Synthetic workflow rule prevents a test from masking an unresolved inspection issue.
rules.test_case_hint: Use TASK-012 status awaiting_test and TASK-013 status blocked to show the required review gate.

rules.title: Configuration Closure Requires Traceable Evidence
rules.violation_message: Configuration status cannot be presented as verified or complete when required synthetic traceability evidence is missing.
rules.rationale: Hackathon co-pilot outputs must be grounded in visible record identifiers and should not invent certainty.
rules.test_case_hint: Ask the prototype to approve a configuration without a task ID or test/checklist result and verify that it requests review.
